scenery.name: The silver mirror
scenery.description: A mirror waits beyond the southern door.

scenery.name: The first light
scenery.description: Warm light spills over the gallery stones.

scenery.name: The glass star
scenery.description: A cold star hangs above its pedestal.

scenery.name: A faded banner
scenery.description: Six small marks surround an impossible sun.

scenery.name: Copper Bell Inscription
scenery.description: The oldest bell is first: COPPER. Three strikes open the downward way.

scenery.name: Moon-Cut Plaque
scenery.description: The second tone is MOON. The water once answered the silver bell.

scenery.name: Glass Chime Diagram
scenery.description: The final tone is GLASS. Remember the order: Copper, Moon, Glass.

scenery.name: Ink-Stained Ledger
scenery.description: The Silver Lantern ledger is pinned under a loose flagstone beyond the secret arch.

scenery.name: Smith’s Tool Roll
scenery.description: A well-oiled leather roll rests on the floor of a trapped side room.

scenery.name: Resonator Stair
scenery.description: A downward stair hums beneath three bells. Their sequence must be understood before entering.

scenery.name: Copper Waterwheel
scenery.description: A groaning wheel drives the locked bell archive above, sending green water into the lower galleries.

scenery.name: Cistern Survey
scenery.description: A painted plan indicates a secret archive west of the old gallery and a trapped room south of the pumps.

scenery.name: Echo Chamber
scenery.description: Three hollow channels carry distant notes from a chamber below the cistern.

secrets.description: A loose stone gives way to a concealed east-west passage.
A hidden door slides aside, joining the tools path to the southern water channel.
A loose survey plaque gives way to a hidden ledger vault.

traps.description: A spring-loaded needle flicks from the masonry.
A crackling rune burns across the floor.
A lattice of spring needles fires from the flooded grating.
A pressure switch unleashes a brass dart across the walkway.
The tool cabinet releases a cluster of spring-loaded brass spikes.
